aboutMore: ok real talk for a second (air horn on mute). my moms van is a studio on sundays and after 5 on weekdays. the rest of the time its a work van. she runs a cleaning business (MISS PAT'S OFFICE CLEANING) and the van is full of mops, buckets, a vacuum and one mic. i help her clean 3 nights a week, thats how i know every echo in Tampa. i can tell the bpm of anything by tapping my foot (a car blinker is 76. a ceiling fan is 'it depends'). my uncle ray in orlando taught me a hook is a promise. thats why track 9 smells like lemon cleaner. (can u smell a track. i can.)

blog.title: WHERE 2 RECORD IN TAMPA: A RANKING (BY ECHO)
blog.body: after 3 nights a week cleaning offices w/ my mom i know every echo in this city. THE LIST. #1: the stairwell at the dentist office on Dale Mabry. A+. 4 seconds of tail. my voice sounds like a guy announcing a boat. #2: the bank vestibule (the little glass room w/ the ATM). B+. tight, bright, 1.2 sec tail. u cant stay long, a guard walked by, i said its a school project, he said ok. #3: the school bathroom. B-. janitor mr ortiz said 'kid thats my office' and let me do one take. #4: the freezer aisle at Publix. C. too cold, my fingers wouldnt work. #5: the van. D+. but its HOME. it has the warmth. the mops are the only audience. DJ SMOOVE SAYS: an echo is a free instrument. u just have 2 know where it lives.

blog.title: RINGTONE ECONOMICS: A BUSINESS REPORT
blog.body: since july ive sold 31 ringtones. REVENUE: $17 cash + 9 capri suns + 1 baseball card (chad, a good one he said, i dont know what it is, its in a sleeve) + 4 'ill pay u later' (tony). EXPENSES: 0 (the razr was a gift). my top seller is a 14 second loop of tony saying 'hey' pitched down. 6 ppl bought it. nobody can say why. my best ringtone is NOT my best seller. my best ringtone is 9 seconds of an air horn and a harp. 1 sale (my mom, 'because you asked'). she uses it for her sister. i dont know what that says about the family. REFUND POLICY: if ur phone rings in class and the teacher takes it u get 1 free replacement. this has happened twice. both were tony. MORAL: the people want 'hey.'

blog.title: UNCLE RAY SAID (A LIST)
blog.body: my uncle ray lives in orlando and played bass in a wedding band for 22 years and he has 3 rules. 1) a hook is a promise. dont make a promise u cant keep 4 more than 3 minutes. 2) leave room. the best beat has a hole in it where the room goes. 3) never play something u wouldnt play 4 ur mom in the kitchen. i said what if she says its noise. he said 'then play it for her until it isnt.' ive been doing that since june. my mom has said 'turn it down' 61 times. last night she said 'turn it up' ONCE. i havent told anybody. im telling the blog. the beat was called Van Beat. i think she liked the hole.

blog.title: TEEN NITE BY MAIL (a report from 1,000 miles away)
blog.body: vince (promoter_vince) runs TEEN NITE at a roller rink in ohio. its a thousand miles from my moms van. he said 'mail me the CD and u come in spirit.' so i burned track 9, wrote DJ SMOOVE PLAY AT COUPLES SKATE on it in sharpie, and mailed it in a padded envelope. the post office lady asked what was in it. i said 'a hit.' she said 'ok.' vince said the limbo bar there is a mop, so i also mailed a spare mop handle from the van. 'a professional one.' the lady asked what was in the tube. i said 'limbo.' she said 'ok.' 6 days later vince reported back: the herp part got a REACTION at couples skate. a lady said 'its very modern.' i looked up modern. it means 'of the present time.' im in the present time. a whole rink heard me and i didnt even have to be there. thats the dream. thats the internet.

survey.title: the PRODUCER survey (copied from a magazine) (air horn)
qa: producer name:
DJ SMOOVE. also 'baby' in my moms phone (shes never changing it) (shes right)
first beat ever made:
age 14. fruity loops demo. 4 kicks and a cowbell. i called it 'Cowbell Hello.' still the best name i ever came up with
equipment:
fruity loops 6, a radioshack mic, uncle rays 4-track, my moms van, the school bathroom (sometimes), headphones w/ 1 working side (the right) (i know)
best song of all time:
its a tie. a timbaland beat and the sound of my mom laughing on the phone in the kitchen. i havent sampled the 2nd one. i never will. its not 4 sale
biggest fear:
fruity loops crashing before i save. it happened 3 times. i now save every 20 seconds. i save so much that i save the saving
what do u eat while producing:
a capri sun and the end of a bag of chips. fuel
biggest influence:
timbaland, the neptunes, uncle ray, and a lady who hummed 1 note in an elevator. perfect note. i never found out her name
dream collab:
timbaland, pharrell, t-pain, and tom (feat. tom) (hes everyones friend, he'd say yes)
who's on ur next track:
u. u dont know yet. its called 'u dont know yet'
favorite sound:
the first second after an air horn. the room is still ringing and nobody has moved yet. best second in music
what does ur mom think:
'turn it down' 61 times. 'turn it up' once. i was there. it happened
describe urself in one sentence:
a guy w/ a radioshack mic, an uncle w/ a 4-track and a mom w/ a van, and thats a whole record label
